svg.text: A NEIGHBORHOOD SHARING ONE SUPPLY · PLAN VIEW · PARTIAL ADOPTION
COORDINATION MESH — PEER TO PEER, NO HUB
SHARED SUPPLY MAIN — SUSTAINS FOUR NODES AT FULL DRAW; TEN PRESENT
EACH NODE DECIDES LOCALLY FROM SHARED STATE · NO COORDINATOR · NO ELECTION · FOUR MAY DRAW AT ONCE
AGGREGATE DRAW NEVER EXCEEDS SUSTAINABLE CAPACITY
NO STRUCTURE EXCEEDS ITS MAXIMUM DRY INTERVAL
UNEQUIPPED STRUCTURES DO NOT STOP THE DOMAIN WORKING
